title: Scene change crashes sometimes
body:
### Tested versions

Found in 4.3 stable and the latest build as of december 14 2024.
git commit hash on the master branch: dc5f1b7a2826962f02230227abc486ac160ae66


### System information

windows 11 even though Godot system info says 10. Godot v4.3.stable - Windows 10.0.22631 - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6603) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 Threads)

### Issue description


Description:
Changing scenes crashes the game only on the second time the game is run or after a few restarts after that. The error on debug build found here: https://github.com/Calinou/godot-debug-builds

```
CrashHandlerException: Program crashed
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.3.stable.custom_build (77dcf97d82cbfe4e4615475fa52ca03da645dbd8)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[0] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[1] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[2] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[3] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[4] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[5] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[6] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[7] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[8] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[9] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[10] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
[11] <couldn't map PC to fn name>
-- END OF BACKTRACE --
```
Found a issue with the same error here: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/94112
but that seems to be a because of a hardware issue and this project crashes when changing scenes.

### Steps to reproduce

In the project goto the door and press j. Close and reload the game and goto the door and press j and the game should crash. If it doesn't crash rerun the game and do it again it. Sometimes it take a few restarts and on the latest build it takes many restarts for it to crash.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/chipset1/godot-scene-change-crash
